idea-plugin.name: DSH Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) inside PyCharm

Embeds the DeepSeek Harness web application directly in PyCharm — a Cursor-style assistant built on your own DSH.

  • Chat with DSH in the context of the open project. DSH keeps working as usual (dsh web): the same beautiful chat UI, models and settings.
  • Multiple independent sessions. Plugin tabs are separate DSH windows, and inside DSH every session in the session list has its own isolated context.
  • Cursor-style TAB completion. Gray inline suggestions from DSH appear right in the editor: Tab accepts, Esc dismisses and schedules a retry in 3 seconds using the whole file. The optional "Extended TAB help" mode allows large continuations (up to 12,000 tokens). A dedicated tool-less DSH completion process answers in ~1–2 s.
  • "Changes" panel. The plugin watches project files, shows a diff for each changed file and lets you accept or reject changes one by one or all at once (reject restores the file to its pre-change state).
  • Settings synchronized through DSH. Plugin settings live in .dsh/pycharm-assistant.json at the project root: the plugin applies them live, and the DSH agent can read and edit them right in the chat. A managed block is added to AGENTS.md so the agent knows about the settings file.
  • Ready to work out of the box. The SDK process starts automatically when the plugin panel opens (this can be turned off in the settings) and can be restarted at any time from the panel menu.

Requirements: PyCharm 2024.3+ (JCEF is bundled) and the DSH CLI (npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh) available in PATH — or set a custom command in Settings → Tools → DSH Assistant.

action.description: Ask DSH about the selected code or the open file
Edit the selected code following an instruction (Cursor Ctrl+K)
Request a DSH inline suggestion at the caret (Tab to accept)
